Using
Lemma <REF_0001>
and the work done in the earlier sections of this chapter it is easy
to make a list of types of morphisms which are smooth local on the
source-and-target. In each case we list the lemma which implies
the property is smooth local on the source and the lemma which implies
the property is smooth local on the target. In each case the third assumption
of
Lemma <REF_0002>
is trivial to check, and we omit it. Here is the list:
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> flat, see
Lemmas <REF_0003> and
<REF_0004>,
<STRUCT_0003> locally of finite presentation, see
Lemmas <REF_0005> and
<REF_0006>,
<STRUCT_0004> locally finite type, see
Lemmas <REF_0007> and
<REF_0008>,
<STRUCT_0005> universally open, see
Lemmas <REF_0009> and
<REF_0010>,
<STRUCT_0006> syntomic, see
Lemmas <REF_0011> and
<REF_0012>,
<STRUCT_0007> smooth, see
Lemmas <REF_0013> and
<REF_0014>,
<STRUCT_0008> add more here as needed.
<STRUCT_0009>
